statements.status_notes: netty 4.1.136.Final is bundled inside Google's prebuilt Java emulators (Pub/Sub, Firestore, Datastore), repackaged here unmodified. CVE-2026-75595 requires crafted input from an adversary. The emulators are local development and testing tools intended to receive traffic only from the developer's own test clients; they hold no production data, so the vulnerable path cannot be exercised by an adversary in their intended use.

netty 4.1.136.Final is bundled inside Google's prebuilt Java emulators (Pub/Sub, Firestore, Datastore), repackaged here unmodified. CVE-2026-75595 requires crafted input from an adversary. The emulators are local development and testing tools intended to receive traffic only from the developer's own test clients; they hold no production data, so the vulnerable path cannot be exercised by an adversary in their intended use.

Netty 4.1.137.Final fixes CVE-2026-75596 in netty-handler but cannot be adopted on Elasticsearch 9.5: selective netty-handler 4.1.137.Final causes HTTPS to hang after TLS completes (TestFipsEnd2End fails on index create; non-FIPS e2e tests time out on the HTTPS readiness probe). Bisect on 9.4 isolated the failure to netty-handler FlowControlHandler changes in 4.1.136+ when loaded via the x-pack-security module. Keep 9.5 on netty-handler 4.1.135.Final until an upstream Elasticsearch or Netty fix lands.
